summary: Notification-sensitivity settings screen (safety-critical). Verified backend endpoints and mobile UI end-to-end. All 13 requested checks PASS: /settings/notifications loads without JS errors; mandatory safety copy 'Alerts for dangerous earthquakes are always on and cannot be switched off' is prominent at top inside the green shield-checkmark panel; all four presets render as tappable peers in the exact order Off → Significant only → Noticeable → Everything nearby; Off is the FIRST peer option and shares identical card styling with the other three (no scary/discouraged styling); default selected on fresh device_id is Noticeable (2px green border + green checkmark-circle icon, other options 1px grey border with empty radio); tapping Off/Significant/Everything each fires POST /api/devices/notification-preset with correct body and the checkmark moves accordingly; GET /api/devices/{did}/notification-preset returns the persisted value on re-fetch (verified via pytest); backend POST with 'garbage' preset returns 400; GET for a never-seen device returns 200 with preset='noticeable' + default_used=true (no 404); back-chevron header returns to home; home link testID='open-notification-settings' navigates to this screen; footer disclaimer 'Turning informational notifications off does not affect emergency alerts…' is visible; red 'Critical Alerts turned OFF' banner does NOT render in current permission state (code path exists behind ios.allowsCriticalAlerts === false). No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.tsx: option cards use accessibilityRole='radio' + accessibilityState={selected} but React Native Web currently does NOT map that to aria-selected on the DOM node (all radios show aria-selected=null in the snapshot). Visual state (green border + checkmark) is correct so this is a screen-reader accessibility nit, not a functional bug. Consider testID on each option for future automation.
